# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `basecamp` MCP server pointing at `https://mcp.basecamp.com/mcp`, with `"placement": "server"` so Grok Bot dials it through the hosted MCP path.
- Auth uses OAuth — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Basecamp's official mark (https://basecamp.com/brand/basecamp-logo-white-plate.png).
